ai-data / Retrieval

Qdrant

Vector search with application-level control.

QOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Build semantic-search and retrieval services using Qdrant's vector database, metadata payloads, and supported filtering capabilities. MoreSpace can design a hosted or self-managed retrieval layer for knowledge assistants, content discovery, and similarity search. We define the data model and operational ownership, then test retrieval quality and access restrictions using the questions and records the application is expected to handle.

Useful outputs

  • Indexed vector collections
  • Relevant results with payload context
  • Operational and retrieval-quality reports

Where we can apply it

  • Knowledge corpus → embedding jobs → filtered vector search → reviewed assistant.
  • Catalog updates → indexed representations → similarity results → discovery interface.
  • Internal records → scoped collection → semantic lookup → operator workspace.
01

Use case 1

Index approved document chunks for a source-aware assistant.

02

Use case 2

Find similar catalog or knowledge items from vector representations.

03

Use case 3

Build metadata-filtered retrieval for separate business collections.

Inputs we need

  • Approved vectors and source content
  • Metadata and collection definitions
  • Hosting and access requirements

Delivery sequence

  • Define collections, identifiers, payloads, and the deployment model.
  • Ingest the approved content and configure filtering for each access scope.
  • Evaluate retrieval and monitor refresh, backup, and recovery routines.

Expert review points

  • Test isolation and authorized search across representative users.
  • Validate retrieved sources before using them in generated answers.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.

  • LlamaIndex
  • LangChain
  • Ollama
  • Embedding providers

Signals we can make visible

  • Retrieval relevance
  • Search latency
  • Index freshness
  • Ingestion success rate

We agree the source, population, period, denominator, and decision behind each measure.
